![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

If `manifest` contains any null or malformed entries in `crop_candidates` or `source_page_assets_by_id` (which is common on the fail-closed path for malformed inputs), `recomputeSummary` will throw unhandled `TypeErrors` when accessing properties like `referenced_by_question_rows`, `page_level_fallback`, `page_exposure_risk`, etc. We should use optional chaining (`?.`) and filter out non-record assets to ensure the validator fails closed gracefully instead of crashing.

```javascript
function recomputeSummary(manifest) {
  const pageAssets = Object.values(manifest?.source_page_assets_by_id ?? {}).filter(isRecord);
  const candidates = asArray(manifest?.crop_candidates);
  return {
    source_page_asset_count: pageAssets.length,
    source_question_row_page_ref_count: pageAssets.reduce(
      (sum, asset) => sum + asArray(asset?.referenced_by_question_rows).length,
      0,
    ),
    crop_candidate_count: candidates.length,
    page_fallback_required_count:
      candidates.filter((candidate) => candidate?.page_level_fallback?.required === true).length,
    candidate_with_neighbor_answer_exposure_count:
      candidates.filter((candidate) => Number(candidate?.page_exposure_risk?.exposed_neighbor_question_count ?? 0) > 0).length,
    accepted_crop_count: candidates.filter((candidate) => candidate?.crop_status === 'accepted').length,
    student_display_allowed_count: candidates.filter((candidate) => candidate?.student_display_allowed === true).length,
    crop_enhancement_not_launch_blocker:
      manifest?.artifact_boundary?.launch_blocker === false
      && candidates.every((candidate) => candidate?.launch_blocker === false),
    generated_crop_asset_count: candidates.filter((candidate) => (
      candidate?.crop_generation?.crop_binary_generated === true
    )).length,
    external_ocr_vlm_model_call_count: candidates.filter((candidate) => (
      candidate?.crop_generation?.external_ocr_vlm_or_model_called === true
    )).length,
  };
}
```

<summary>References</summary>

1. Ensure readback or report generation functions are null-safe and use defensive guards, optional chaining, and safe default objects when dereferencing properties from potentially missing or malformed input artifacts, allowing the script to fail-closed gracefully instead of throwing a TypeError.
</details>

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

If `pageAssets` contains any null or non-record elements due to malformed input files, mapping over them directly will throw a `TypeError`. We should filter out non-record elements using `isRecord` to ensure robust, fail-closed execution.

```suggestion
function buildCropCandidates(pageAssets) {
  return pageAssets
    .filter(isRecord)
    .flatMap((pageAsset) => asArray(pageAsset.referenced_by_question_rows)
      .map((questionRowId) => cropCandidateFromPageAsset(pageAsset, questionRowId)))
    .sort((left, right) => compareString(left.crop_candidate_id, right.crop_candidate_id));
}
```

<summary>References</summary>

1. Implement defensive guards when processing data layers, rows, or file inputs to handle missing file hashes, non-array inputs, nullish entries, and validator diagnostics gracefully, preventing TypeErrors and raw file system errors.
</details>
Fixed in 10d3f4fbd. `cloneJson` now returns `undefined` for undefined input instead of parsing it, and the malformed-input regression exercises this path.
Fixed in 10d3f4fbd. `recomputeSummary` now filters non-record page assets, uses record-only candidates for dereferences, preserves raw candidate count, and uses optional chaining for malformed rows.
Fixed in 10d3f4fbd. `source_artifacts` entries now fail closed with `source_artifact_role_invalid` and `source_artifact_path_invalid` when role/path are not non-empty strings.
Fixed in 10d3f4fbd. `buildCropCandidates` now normalizes through `asArray` and filters non-record page assets before reading row refs.
Fixed in 10d3f4fbd. `indexPageAssets` now normalizes through `asArray`, filters non-record entries, and only indexes records with a non-empty `ms_page_asset_id`.
